note: Paper books on the scanner's forward log (forward.db). Registered BEFORE any of their trades existed: only signals whose trigger candle opens at or after 'start' count (that candle closes 06:00 UTC, after registration at 05:18 UTC). Each signal = 50 USDT margin at 3x (150 USDT position), entry/target/stop/time exactly as the forward log records them, 0.2% round-trip costs and funding included (ret_pct); a loss is capped at the 50 USDT margin. Nothing is traded. Rules and settings are not changed afterwards; a new idea gets a new book with its own start.
